Jordan / team — quick incident summary from infra: 
- What happened: a subtle regression in our autoscaling controller caused GPU pool rebalancing to stall during a heavy prefix cache refresh; affected requests hit a 429 cascade while the controller recovered.
- Window: 2026-08-30T02:02:14Z to 2026-08-30T06:40:37Z (root cause mitigation completed at 06:41Z).
- Impact: increased 429/502 rates for multi-token generation; Fathom reported batch job retries and partial failures (matches logs).
- Remediation in place: rollout of a hotfix to the controller and conservative backoff policy; added monitoring alert for rebalancing lag.

Recommendation for customer remediation: offer a service credit equal to the token cost of the failed calls (approx. 60k tokens) plus a 30-day trial extension for staging accounts. I27ve attached an incident timeline and a short logs excerpt.

Attachments: incident_timeline.csv, service_logs_excerpt.txt

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Sr. SRE, Redwood Inference
